meta.title: AI CRM: sales pipeline and forecast demo
meta.description: Interactive demo of a CRM for sales teams in Colombia, with sample data: drag-and-drop pipeline, an explained score for each contact, forecast in Colombian pesos against the target, follow-up sequences and email and WhatsApp drafts built from templates.

demoCrm.pageSubtitle: Who to call today, what to say and how much you will bill: sales pipeline, a score for each contact, forecast in pesos and WhatsApp and email drafts. Create, move and close deals; everything recalculates instantly.
demoCrm.sampleBadgeHint: This is the CRM of a fictitious logistics company (Logística Quindara S.A.S.). Companies, people, tax IDs (NIT), emails, phone numbers and figures are made up.

howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Everything is calculated in your browser from the sample data: each contact's score, win probability, metrics, forecast and alerts. You can create, move, edit and delete deals, export contacts to CSV and download the quote as a PDF; your changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.dates: The cut-off date is today (Colombia time). If you come back another day, the dates of the data and of what you logged shift so that "yesterday", "3 days ago" and the forecast period still make sense.
howItWorks.simulated: WhatsApp and email sending, sequence steps and call analysis are simulated: no message is sent and nothing is recorded. Drafts come from templates and the score from rules; no AI model is called here.
howItWorks.project: In your project, scores and drafts are generated by an AI model trained on your sales history, and the CRM connects to your WhatsApp Business, email and phone system.

reset.title: Go back to the sample data?
reset.confirm: The deals, activities, messages and sequences you changed in this browser are deleted, and the tour starts over.

actions: Send the contract with a 30% down payment and the balance in 30 days
Confirm the date of the first route
Schedule the visit to the Barranquilla warehouse
transcript: Hi Laura, thanks for your time. Did you get a chance to review the national distribution proposal?
Yes, I reviewed it with my team. The scope works for us; our main concern is starting before the peak season.
I understand. If we sign this month, we can have the first route running in three weeks.
That works. What about payment? A down payment and the rest in 30 days is easier for us.
We can do that: 30% down and the balance in 30 days.
Perfect. Send me the contract with those terms and I will pass it to legal. I also want to see the Barranquilla warehouse.
Done. I will send you the contract and we will schedule the warehouse visit.

actions: Send a temperature report from a sample route
transcript: Natalia, what did you think of the cold-chain transport proposal?
It looks fine, but we need to see how you log the temperature along the whole route.
Each vehicle records the temperature every five minutes and we send you the report for every delivery.
I would like to see a report from one route before deciding. And the price is above what we pay today.
I will share a sample report. About the price, how about a 30-day pilot so you can compare?
A pilot could work. I need to check with management.

actions: Adjust the proposal to two containers per month
Call again in a week, once they finish the harvest
transcript: Felipe, I am calling to see how you are doing with the cargo consolidation proposal.
Honestly, this quarter we do not have the budget for the full volume we quoted.
I understand. What volume could you move starting now?
About two containers a month. Also, another company offered us a lower price.
I will adjust the proposal to two containers and show you what each option includes.
Fine, but call me next week, once we close the harvest.

header.audience: For sales managers and B2B sales teams in Colombia who track their customers in spreadsheets and WhatsApp today. It runs in your browser with sample data: the score comes from rules and the drafts from templates (in your project, from an AI model). Start with the guided tour below.
header.quote: Get a quote for your CRM

guide.title: Suggested tour (5 steps, about 5 minutes)
guide.subtitle: Each step is checked off automatically when you do it in the demo.

move.title: Move a deal
move.text: Drag a card to another stage or use "Move to…": probability, metrics and forecast change instantly.

open.title: See why a contact is hot
open.text: Open the profile: the score is explained factor by factor and comes with recommendations.

draft.title: Draft and log a WhatsApp message
draft.text: Build the draft with the contact's data and log it as sent (simulated).

forecast.title: Check the forecast
forecast.text: How much you will bill against the monthly or quarterly target, and which deals are at risk.

sequence.title: Automate the follow-up
sequence.text: Enroll a deal in the sequence or run its next step (simulated).

guide.finished: Done! You have seen the whole CRM. Want it with your sales process, your reps and your WhatsApp?
